coaching.summary: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the bar across your hips, then drive your hips up until shoulders, hips and knees line up.
cues: Rest the bench just under your shoulder blades and pad the bar in the hip crease.
Tuck the chin and keep the ribs down so the hips do the work, not the lower back.
Drive through the heels to full lockout with shins vertical, then lower under control.
coaching.videoTitle: Hip Thrust Tutorial - Proper Form and Technique - Runna

standardsRef.note: Most lifters thrust more than they squat, so 1.0 starts on the light side.
